#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
SRC="/home/openclaw/.openclaw/agents/main/sessions"
DEST="/home/openclaw/.openclaw/workspace/sessions"
mkdir -p "$DEST"
# Find .jsonl files and copy newer ones
SYNCED_FILES=""
while IFS= read -r srcfile; do
  relpath="${srcfile#$SRC/}"
  destfile="$DEST/$relpath"
  destdir=$(dirname "$destfile")
  mkdir -p "$destdir"
  if [ ! -e "$destfile" ] || [ "$srcfile" -nt "$destfile" ]; then
    cp -p "$srcfile" "$destfile"
    SYNCED_FILES+="$relpath\n"
  fi
done < <(find "$SRC" -type f -name "*.jsonl")
if [ -z "$SYNCED_FILES" ]; then
  echo "No files synced."
  exit 0
fi
# Trim trailing newline
SYNCED_FILES=$(echo -e "$SYNCED_FILES" | sed '/^$/d')
# Add and commit
cd "$DEST"
git add $SYNCED_FILES
COMMIT_MSG="Sync sessions: $(echo $SYNCED_FILES | tr '\n' ' ')"
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "No changes to commit."
else
  git commit -m "$COMMIT_MSG"
  git push
fi
